column1: # The in-game PC menu's strings (scripts/menu_assets.py adds them to every language's
# menu.msgbnd.dcx). Ids and wording after droogie's bbhost (tools/pc_option_messages.tsv).
# Bloodborne's option screens own one thousand-id block each: 110000 System, 111000
# Environment, ... 115000 Language. Inside a block, N is a row and N+20 is the screen title;
# N+100.. are a row's choices. The PC menu takes 116000 PC Settings, 117000 PC Graphics,
# 120000 PC Effects, 124000 PC Enhancements, 125000 PC Display, 126000 PC Gameplay and
# 127000 PC Cheats and 128000 Achievements, and 110006..110018 for the System rows that open them; all are unused in
# Ids 920000..929999 are dialog text (groups 78 and 204, yes/no questions); 122000 is the
# Ids 14000332..14000399 are event text (group 30): talk menu entries and the messages their
# scripts show (the Altar of Despair's rebirth); the help column is unused.
# A "\n" in the text is a line break. Line help stays within 52 characters (the help bar).
